name: Cheer Moe ~Watashi Ouen Shiteru Kara~
original_name: チアもえ～わたし応艶してるからっ～
source:
The school looks normal at first sight. There is the cheer leading club and the members practice hard every day. Do they only cheer during games? Well, actually no. The cheer learders also leave stress of sport club members using their bodies....
